## Où j'en suis
PR #418 is merged. The follow-up keyboard move/resize and visible focus-ring work is committed as `8f1a2c7` on `tom/dashboard-keyboard` and PR #423 is open. `dashboards_v2` is enabled for Zest on staging; production remains off. (source: ses-db-4, kestrel-analytics/platform#418, kestrel-analytics/platform#423)

- [en-cours] PR #423 is awaiting review; keyboard interaction and focus-ring tests pass. (source: ses-db-4, kestrel-analytics/platform#423, 8f1a2c7)
- [prochaine-étape] Get PR #423 reviewed; Priya can rehearse the demo on staging. Production flag is to be enabled by the user on the morning of the 24th. (source: ses-db-4, d4-06)
- [essai-raté] Wrapping the grid in dnd-kit caused keyboard moves and mouse-drag layout changes to fire twice because both it and react-grid-layout handled the same events. dnd-kit was removed; the custom layout-state handler works. (source: d4-02, d4-05)
- [décision] Use a custom keyboard handler on top of layout state, not dnd-kit. (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Keep production untouched for now; enable the flag for Zest on staging, with production planned for the morning of the 24th. (source: d4-06)
